verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ClickHouse has a general HTTP interface (e.g., X-ClickHouse-Format header) but no mention of an official driver purpose-built for serverless/edge runtimes, WebSocket support, or short-lived-connection optimization. missing for 10: an official edge/serverless HTTP or WebSocket client library, documentation of connection pooling/short-lived connection handling, and any mention of WebSocket protocol support.
